_source: Apna Tutor content for the journey film. Every string and number is taken from the intake and the text of apnatutor.live (home + pricing) as captured for the bake-off; nothing is invented. 'From $5 per 60-min session' is the site's hero line.
one_liner: Online 1-on-1 tutoring from India for NRI kids, TK to 10th grade.
problem: US tutors charge $60–$80 an hour, making tutoring expensive for families.
